text:
Ivy: Help me pick a two-track nightcap. I have exactly 12 minutes and want something that feels like a tiny story. :crescent_moon:
Noah: Two tracks that feel like a short arc: Nick Drake - 'Pink Moon' (3:30) then Joni Mitchell - 'A Case of You' (4:15). tender -> bittersweet.
Sera: Or go cinematic: play Olafur Arnalds - 'Near Light' (5:00) then the 7-minute short film 'The Answers' (drop link below).
Ben: For silly comfort: The Shins - 'New Slang' (3:52) + Simon & Garfunkel - 'The Only Living Boy in New York' (3:58). nostalgic.
Ivy: Vote: :sparkles: for soft/cinematic, :heart: for warm/folk, :laughing: for silly comfort.
Noah: :sparkles:
Sera: :sparkles: (film link: https://vimeo.com/clip/98765432)
Ben: :heart: (but secretly :laughing:)
Ivy: OK sparkles wins. I'll do Arnalds + 'The Answers' on the kitchen projector. Anyone want tea?
Sera: I'll bring chamomile.
snack-bot: Cupboard status: chamomile x3, black tea x10, cookies x5. :cookie:
Noah: Tiny bedtime read rec: 'The Paper Menagerie' (Ken Liu) if you want to stay in the feels after. 5-10min.
Ivy: Perfect. Thanks folks. Opening projector at 9:30. Bring feelings and/or cookies. :raised_hands:
